svg.title: global-health-radar
svg.desc: Microservices. $0 hosting bill. A worldwide disease tracker: Spring Boot services behind a JWT gateway, with a transactional outbox, PostGIS and two levels of caching, all running on free hosting. Built with Java 25, Spring Boot 4, Next.js 16, PostGIS, Redis.

g.text: A worldwide disease tracker: Spring Boot services behind a JWT
gateway, with a transactional outbox, PostGIS and two levels of
caching, all running on free hosting.
